name: Azure DevOps
label: Azure DevOps REST API
description: Azure DevOps REST (api-version 7.2) via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/devops/?view=azure-devops-rest-7.2. Operations: workitem_create, workitem_get, workitem_update, workitem_query, workitem_comment, workitem_link, pr_create, pr_get, build_queue, build_get, release_get, git_push_listen, listen. release_get uses per-op baseUrl https://vsrm.dev.azure.com (GET /{organization}/{project}/_apis/release/releases/{releaseId}). Auth secret personal_access_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). JDK HTTP, official API only. Inbound webhooks: selecting a :listen operation (git_push_listen / listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification config (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: workitem_create | workitem_get | workitem_update | workitem_query | workitem_comment | workitem_link | pr_create | pr_get | build_queue | build_get | release_get | git_push_listen | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. git_push_listen / listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'workitem_create'.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Work item id path for workitem_get/update/comment/link. Example: 131489.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Work item type path ${type} for workitem_create. Example: Bug | Task | User Story | Feature | Epic.

schema.label: query
schema.description: WIQL string body for workitem_query. Example: SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.WorkItemType] = 'Bug'.

schema.label: api-version
schema.description: REST api-version query on every call. Set 7.2 or 7.2-preview.3. Example: 7.2.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: JSON Patch array sent as the whole workitem_create body (Content-Type application/json-patch+json). Each item is {op, path, value}. System.Title is required: [{"op":"add","path":"/fields/System.Title","value":"Bug"}]. Common paths: /fields/System.Title, /fields/System.Description, /fields/System.AssignedTo, /fields/System.AreaPath, /fields/System.IterationPath, /fields/System.Tags, /fields/Microsoft.VSTS.Common.Priority. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/devops/wit/work-items/create

schema.label: operations
schema.description: JSON Patch array sent as the whole workitem_update / workitem_link body. Example replace title: [{"op":"replace","path":"/fields/System.Title","value":"Fixed"}]. Link example: [{"op":"add","path":"/relations/-","value":{"rel":"System.LinkTypes.Hierarchy-Forward","url":"https://dev.azure.com/{org}/{project}/_apis/wit/workItems/42"}}].

schema.label: text
schema.description: Comment HTML/text for workitem_comment (body text). Example: Please review.

schema.label: repositoryId
schema.description: Git repository id for pr_create / pr_get.

schema.label: sourceRefName
schema.description: Source branch ref for pr_create. Example: refs/heads/feature/login.

schema.label: targetRefName
schema.description: Target branch ref for pr_create. Example: refs/heads/main.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Pull request title for pr_create. Example: Add login.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Pull request description for pr_create.

schema.label: pullRequestId
schema.description: Pull request id for pr_get.

schema.label: definition
schema.description: Build definition for build_queue. Official shape {id: <definitionId>}. Example: {"id":12}.

schema.label: sourceBranch
schema.description: Branch to build for build_queue. Example: refs/heads/main.

schema.label: buildId
schema.description: Build id for build_get.

schema.label: releaseId
schema.description: Release id for release_get (vsrm.dev.azure.com).

schema.label: $expand
schema.description: Work item expand for workitem_get (and optional create). EXACT: None | Relations | Fields | Links | All.

schema.label: validateOnly
schema.description: Query validateOnly for workitem_create/update: validate without saving. Example: false.

schema.label: bypassRules
schema.description: Query bypassRules for workitem_create/update: skip work-item type rules. Example: false.

schema.label: suppressNotifications
schema.description: Query suppressNotifications for workitem_create/update. Example: false.

schema.label: reviewers
schema.description: Optional reviewers for pr_create: [{id or descriptor}]. Example: [{"id":"d291b0c4-…"}].

schema.label: isDraft
schema.description: Create the PR as draft (pr_create). Example: false.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.
